section_summary.extract_value: This section (2.2.3) describes the measurement of online interpersonal sexual objectification (OISO) using six items adapted from the Interpersonal Sexual Objectification Scale and items added for QQ features; participants responded on a 5-point frequency scale. Reliability and factor structure are reported: Cronbach's α = 0.82; EFA produced one factor accounting for 52.49% variance (KMO = 0.74, Bartlett's χ2(15)=2687.32, p < .001); CFA fit indices were RMSEA = 0.072, CFI = 0.987, TLI = 0.967, SRMR = 0.021. The section does not report study-level sample size, demographics, country, survey method, BMI, or correlations with body appreciation.
